jina: Prohibition against forming armed forces other than public armed forces
maudhui: (1) It is hereby prohibited for any person, or any organization or any group of persons, except the Government, to raise or maintain in Tanzania an armed force of any kind. (2) The Government of the United Republic may, in accordance with law, raise and maintain in Tanzania armed forces of various kinds for the defence and security of the territory and the people of Tanzania. (3) It shall be unlawful for any member of the armed forces to join any political party, save only that he shall have the right to vote which is specified in Article 5 of this Constitution. (4) For the purposes of this Article, “member of the armed forces” means a member of the armed forces who is employed on temporary or permanent terms in the Defence Forces, the Police Force, the Prisons Service or the National Service.
vifungu: (1) It is hereby prohibited for any person, or any organization or any group of persons, except the Government, to raise or maintain in Tanzania an armed force of any kind.

(2) The Government of the United Republic may, in accordance with law, raise and maintain in Tanzania armed forces of various kinds for the defence and security of the territory and the people of Tanzania.
(3) It shall be unlawful for any member of the armed forces to join any political party, save only that he shall have the right to vote which is specified in Article 5 of this Constitution.

(4) For the purposes of this Article, “member of the armed forces” means a member of the armed forces who is employed on temporary or permanent terms in the Defence Forces, the Police Force, the Prisons Service or the National Service.
